description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git log' command with various options and scenarios such as grep, author, regex, pickaxe, and handling of binary files. It defines functions for executing tests, sets up different test repositories, and verifies expected behaviors and error messages.

methods.name: test_log
methods.description: Executes a git log command with specific options and compares the output to an expected result.

methods.name: test_log_icase
methods.description: Runs 'test_log' with case-insensitive options to test case-insensitive matching.
